unverified_boundaries: Agent routing, interactive identifier clarification, and end-to-end output review have not been runtime-evaluated.
Scientific benchmark performance and human-expert review have not been established.

The bundled official-shape replay self-test covers one single-assertion record, one conflicting aggregate, one empty result, explicit provider error/warning envelopes, nonblocking FIFO rejection, output confinement and parent-symlink rejection, malformed and DTD-bearing XML, strict connector metadata, identifier/version drift, duplicate SCV/RCV identities, provenance binding, determinism, atomic rollback, and no-overwrite behavior; broader XML variants and provider drift remain unevaluated.

One bounded public record retrieved through exact VCV and numeric Variation-ID forms preserved the same 87 ClinicalAssertions and 17 RCV accessions; other large assertion sets, somatic classifications, structural variants, deleted records, live not-found behavior, rate limits, and multi-record provider failures remain unverified.
The helper preserves selected identity, classification, condition, date, and provenance fields plus complete classification and condition subtrees; it is not a complete ClinVar archive export.
Free-text resolution, Allele-ID guessing, RCV- or SCV-led retrieval, ACMG classification, evidence scoring, conflict resolution, diagnosis, treatment, and clinical use are outside this preview.

decision_sequence.applies_when: One or more requested identifiers are bare integers and the caller has not explicitly identified them as ClinVar Variation IDs rather than Allele IDs.
decision_sequence.question: Does each bare integer come from a field explicitly labeled ClinVar Variation ID?
decision_sequence.recommended_answer: Require the issuer-recorded Variation ID label; do not infer the namespace from the number.

runtime_versions: Python 3.12.8 self-test; compatible syntax requires Python >=3.10
